card.name: Overdose and poisoning wording
card.fires_on: The word overdose (or its pieces, like overd and Over-d) in overdosage sections, especially after tricyclic. Also 'reach' in 'out of reach of children' warnings.

modes.label: Overdose term
modes.description: The word overdose or overdosage, often split into pieces, in management and decontamination text.
modes.example: All patients suspected of tricyclic<< overdose>> should receive gastrointestinal decontamination.

modes.label: Child-safety warning
modes.description: The word reach in 'keep out of reach of children' next to accidental overdose warnings.
modes.example: Keep this product out of<< reach>> of children.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about toxicity, poisoning, ingestion and children at risk.
card.plain: It lights up on the word overdose and on keep-out-of-reach-of-children warnings, where poisoning is the topic.
